name: Lone Star Freight Systems Inc.
primaryCause: Diesel Fuel Inflation & Spot Freight Rate Collapse
sourceName: U.S. Bankruptcy Court S.D. Tex. Subchapter V Petition
summary: Houston-based regional freight carrier filed Subchapter V small business bankruptcy to restructure $4.5M in equipment debt across 24 Peterbilt commercial trucks & refrigerated trailers.
earlyWarningSignals: Diesel fuel credit line default in June 2026
Notice of default from PACCAR Financial Services

anatomyBreakdown.structural: Mid-market fleet operator reliant on spot market rates without long-term shipper contracts.
anatomyBreakdown.financial: $4.5M secured truck financing debt against declining freight revenues.
anatomyBreakdown.market: Overcapacity in domestic trucking market drove spot rates below operating costs.
anatomyBreakdown.regulatory: Subchapter V fast-track 90-day reorganization plan filed under 11 U.S.C. § 1189.

timeline.event: Default notice issued by PACCAR Financial on 14 truck leases.
Files Subchapter V bankruptcy petition in Houston, TX.

keyTakeaways: Subchapter V allows small fleet operators to retain equity while restructuring secured equipment debt.
Equipment resellers can target 24 Peterbilt trucks entering 363 auction procedures.

name: Sunshine Dining Group LLC (6-Unit Franchisee)
primaryCause: Commercial Rent Increases & Minimum Wage Spikes
sourceName: U.S. Bankruptcy Court M.D. Fla. Subchapter V Petition
summary: Orlando-based 6-location fast-casual restaurant franchisee filed Subchapter V to reject 4 overpriced retail leases and auction commercial kitchen equipment.
earlyWarningSignals: Landlord eviction notices served on 3 locations in July 2026
Food supply distributor debt default ($620K uncollateralized)

anatomyBreakdown.structural: High commercial rent leases eating up 18% of gross revenues.
anatomyBreakdown.financial: $3.2M total liabilities against $850K in liquidation asset value.
anatomyBreakdown.market: Foot traffic dropped 22% due to local consumer belt-tightening.
anatomyBreakdown.regulatory: Subchapter V plan submitted with lease rejection motions.

timeline.event: Served 3-day eviction notices by Florida commercial landlords.
Files Subchapter V bankruptcy in Orlando, FL.

keyTakeaways: Restaurant equipment resellers can bid on walk-in freezers, stainless steel ovens, and POS systems.
Commercial real estate brokers can pick up prime Florida retail leases.
docketStatusBadge: ⚡ LEASE REJECTION & KITCHEN AUCTION IN PROGRESS

name: Pacific Coast CRE Partners LLC
primaryCause: Commercial Mortgage Refinancing Maturity Wall & 40% Vacancy
sourceName: U.S. Bankruptcy Court C.D. Cal. Subchapter V Petition
summary: Los Angeles commercial real estate holding company defaulted on a $6.9M CMBS loan securing a 35,000 sq ft suburban retail shopping center.
assetLiquidationBadge: 🏬 35,000 Sq Ft Retail Shopping Center & Leases
earlyWarningSignals: Anchor retail tenant filed Chapter 11 in May 2026
CMBS loan special servicing transfer in June 2026

anatomyBreakdown.structural: Suburban retail shopping center hit by e-commerce migration and tenant bankruptcies.
anatomyBreakdown.financial: $6.9M senior mortgage matured without refinancing availability.
anatomyBreakdown.market: Property cap rates expanded from 5.5% to 8.8%, destroying equity value.
anatomyBreakdown.regulatory: Section 363 credit bid auction ordered by Central District of California.

timeline.event: Loan transferred to Special Servicing for non-payment at maturity.
Files Subchapter V Chapter 11 in Los Angeles, CA.

keyTakeaways: Commercial real estate investors can acquire 35,000 sq ft California retail property via credit bid auction.
Subchapter V protects property owners from immediate lender foreclosure sales.

name: Empire State Diagnostic Imaging PC
primaryCause: Insurance Reimbursement Cutbacks & Equipment Lease Default
sourceName: U.S. Bankruptcy Court E.D. N.Y. Subchapter V Petition
summary: Brooklyn outpatient diagnostic imaging center filed Subchapter V to restructure $2.7M in Siemens MRI & CT scanner equipment leases following insurer reimbursement rate reductions.
assetLiquidationBadge: 🩺 Siemens MRI, CT Scanners & Ultrasound Systems
earlyWarningSignals: Commercial insurer Medicare Advantage reimbursement cut 18%
Equipment lease default notice from Siemens Financial

anatomyBreakdown.structural: Outpatient clinic vulnerable to insurer fee schedule adjustments.
anatomyBreakdown.financial: High fixed monthly leases on 3T MRI machines exceeding patient volume revenue.
anatomyBreakdown.market: Consolidation of local healthcare networks diverted physician referrals.
anatomyBreakdown.regulatory: Subchapter V plan filed to cram down uncollateralized lease debt.

timeline.event: Siemens Financial issues formal notice of default on MRI equipment.
Files Subchapter V Chapter 11 in Brooklyn, NY.

keyTakeaways: Medical equipment resellers can acquire Siemens 3T MRI and 64-slice CT scanners.
Subchapter V allows medical practices to renegotiate equipment leases under Section 365.

name: Midwest Metal Stamping & Tooling Inc.
sourceName: U.S. Bankruptcy Court N.D. Ill. Subchapter V Petition
summary: Chicago-based Tier-2 automotive metal stamping facility filed Subchapter V to liquidate 18 CNC stamping presses, industrial tooling, and 40,000 sq ft industrial plant.
earlyWarningSignals: Tier-1 auto supplier cancelled major stamping contract in April 2026
Comerica Bank revolving credit facility default notice

anatomyBreakdown.structural: Capital-intensive auto parts supplier with high fixed debt service on heavy presses.
anatomyBreakdown.financial: $5.8M bank debt against $3.1M machine auction value.
anatomyBreakdown.market: EV transition reduced demand for traditional internal combustion stamping parts.
anatomyBreakdown.regulatory: Section 363 industrial auction scheduled by U.S. Bankruptcy Court in Chicago.

timeline.event: Primary automotive buyer cancels annual purchase agreement.
Files Subchapter V bankruptcy in Chicago, IL.

keyTakeaways: Industrial machinery liquidators can purchase 18 CNC presses and metal tooling for 25 cents on the dollar.
Midwest industrial real estate buyers can bid on 40,000 sq ft Chicago manufacturing plant.
